title: Event
description: An event, the editorial description of the exchanged media

truncatedDateTimeType.description: Allows any of year (xs:gYear, YYYY), year/month (xs:gYearMonth, YYYY-MM), year/month/day (xs:date YYYY-MM-DD), and full datetime (xs:dateTime, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM), all with an optional timezone suffix. Note that this does NOT include ISO8601 month of year (xs:gMonth, --MM) or yearly day (xs:gMonthDay, --MM-DD)

id.title: LPX event ID
id.description: Unique identifier for use with LPX API endpoints

version.title: Version
version.description: Version of the live event, incremented when an update is performed

versionCreated.title: Version Created
versionCreated.description: The date and time when this version of the live event was created

contentCreated.title: Content Created
contentCreated.description: The date and time when the live event was created

copyrightHolder.title: Copyright Holder
copyrightHolder.description: The person or organization claiming the intellectual property for the content

copyrightNotice.title: Copyright Notice
copyrightNotice.description: Any necessary copyright notice for claiming the intellectual property for the content

usageTerms.title: Usage Terms
usageTerms.description: Statement about the usage terms pertaining to the content

eventDetails.title: Event Details
eventDetails.description: A container for properties related to a planned event

dates.title: Event Dates
dates.description: A container for properties related to dates and times for this event

startDate.title: Scheduled Start Date
startDate.description: Scheduled date and (optionally) time of the start of the event

endDate.title: Scheduled End Date
endDate.description: Scheduled date and (optionally) time of the end of the event

scheduledDuration.title: Scheduled Duration
scheduledDuration.description: Planned/scheduled duration of live event. Must use iCalendar duration format (RFC 5545).

actualStartDate.title: Actual Start Date
actualStartDate.description: Actual date and time of the start of the event, generally populated retrospectively

actualEndDate.title: Actual End Date
actualEndDate.description: Actual date and time of the end of the event, generally populated retrospectively

eventStatus.title: Event Status
eventStatus.description: Current status of live event. Suggested values are from https://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/eventstatus/

plannedCoverageStatus.title: Planned Coverage Status
plannedCoverageStatus.description: Status of planned coverage. Suggested values are from https://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/eventoccurstatus/

renditions.title: Renditions
renditions.description: A list of renditions associated with the event. Currently supports only TAMS video renditions.
